reviews.text:
Assalamu Alaikum,

I was visiting Peoria with my family and decided to offer Salah at MSA Musallah. Unfortunately, I was quite disappointed and concerned to see the unclean and unhygienic condition of the facility.

My wife had to pray in the basement and could barely offer her Salah due to the presence of roaches and spiders throughout the area. There was also a strong moldy smell and what appeared to be significant mold/moisture issues, to the point that the smell was difficult to tolerate for someone simply coming in to pray. Unfortunately, the main prayer area was not much better.

The Masajid are the houses of Allah ﷻ, and we have a responsibility to keep them clean, welcoming, and suitable for people to worship. The Prophet ﷺ said:

«عُرِضَتْ عَلَيَّ أَعْمَالُ أُمَّتِي حَسَنُهَا وَسَيِّئُهَا، فَوَجَدْتُ فِي مَحَاسِنِ أَعْمَالِهَا إِمَاطَةَ الْأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ، وَوَجَدْتُ فِي مَسَاوِئِ أَعْمَالِهَا النُّخَاعَةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ لَا تُدْفَنُ»

The Prophet ﷺ also instructed that masajid be kept clean and free from impurities and unpleasant odors. Maintaining the cleanliness of the masjid is therefore not merely a matter of appearance—it is part of respecting the house of Allah ﷻ and providing a dignified environment for worshippers.

I humbly request the management and those responsible for maintaining this facility to please address this matter as a priority. At a minimum, the masjid and basement urgently need a professional deep cleaning, mold/moisture remediation, and professional pest-control service to eliminate the roaches, spiders, and other pests and prevent them from returning.

If the condition of the building requires it, I would strongly encourage considering a gut rehabilitation or major renovation so that the facility can be restored to a clean, safe, healthy, and welcoming environment.

I am sharing this not to criticize anyone, but out of genuine concern and respect for the Musallah and for the brothers and sisters who come there to worship. May Allah ﷻ reward everyone who contributes to maintaining His house and make this Musallah a clean, safe, and welcoming place for the entire community. Ameen.

Please develop a clear plan to ensure that travelers, visitors, and anyone coming to pray have reliable access to the masjid. It is extremely disappointing that—not just this masjid, but many others—remain locked and inaccessible during prayer times.

Today I came for Asr, and the parking lot was full of cars. There was a meeting going on in the education room, yet the main door was locked. Even after repeatedly ringing the bell, no one opened it.

This reflects very poor management for a masjid whose primary purpose is to provide a place for people to offer salah. All community activities are secondary. The basic obligation of keeping the masjid accessible for prayer should never be compromised.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback.

We understand the importance of having access to a masjid for prayer, especially for travelers and visitors. For the safety and security of our congregants and facility, our building access hours are clearly posted on our website and at the entrance doors. The masjid is generally unlocked 20 minutes before and after each congregational prayer.

Based on the timing you described, the Asr prayer had already concluded and the building had been secured in accordance with our posted policy. While there was an activity taking place in our education area, it is located separately from the musallah and entrance, and participants would not have been aware of someone ringing the doorbell.

We recognize that this was frustrating and regret that your visit did not go as expected. At the same time, we remain committed to balancing accessibility with the safety and security of everyone who uses our facility.

Thank you again for your feedback and for visiting our masjid.

reviews.text:
Assalamu alaikum, brothers and sisters! 🤲🏻

I would like to share some wonderful news — a new mosque has opened in Elgin 🕌. It is a very beautiful and peaceful place for worship, with a calm and spiritual atmosphere. Special thanks to the Imam — he is very kind, wise, and welcoming to everyone who comes.

Friday prayers (Jumu’ah) and Taraweeh prayers during Ramadan are held at the mosque 🌙. The atmosphere is very friendly, and everyone feels like part of one big family.

The mosque is open to everyone — feel free to come for prayer, meet brothers and sisters, strengthen your faith, and spend time in a blessed place. 🤲🏻✨

May Allah accept our prayers and unite us in goodness. 🕌🤍
